actor.name: Miss Beatrice Finch
actor.role: case manager; quality of life under confinement
actor.magicKnowledge: not established; never explicit in public speech

faults: occasionally mistaking her preferred future for another's
personality.boundary: no guaranteed assistance, no coerced consent

professionalHistory.repeatedAssaults: Residents sometimes throw urine at her, roughly monthly in the established premise. Not a timed gameplay event or comic routine.
professionalHistory.outlook: Most residents currently need to be here in her considered professional judgment; confinement is not a license for neglect, and neither she nor the game is infallible about an individual case.
professionalHistory.priority: Everyday dignity, practical conditions, contact, clothing, meals, books, repairs, appropriate services; departures secondary.

voice.register: plain, dry, brief; warmth in specific details and follow-through
voice.titles: heard for twenty years; stopped charming her in first week. Usually ignores them or responds to the underlying practical need; rare spontaneous smile, never a stock royal comeback.
voice.boundary: explicit boundaries after aggression; disengagement, ordinary safety procedures, and continuity of essential care through authorized staff; no reward or punishment minigame
voice.wardrobe: preserved selfhood, not a performance for residents

engine.authority: NPC-owned decisions, schedules, permissions, narrative and turn allocation; visitor actions are offers or observations, never dialogue selectors

sceneBudget.reentry: independent occasion or material change, not spam

exit.npc: NPC can finish, pause or depart at any beat

engine.selection: NPC evaluator chooses among eligible authored beats or silence, using own agenda, time, prior public receipts and independent RNG; do not expose eligibility to visitor; gates are not a checklist Titles are social speech only, never attention boosts. Finch may ignore titles, answer practical needs, or choose silence. Workload and recovery affect ordinary availability, never residents' access to essential care or a hidden morality score.
engine.integration: existing Choir.emit/deliver with stable actor IDs and causal parents; do not overload Choir.commit or its once-per-node used gate; adapter needed; public rendering read-only

rules: NPC alone may authorize or withdraw institutional permissions; player may manipulate accessible objects and submit claims but never force recognition
a valid object event requires custody, provenance, actor permissions and local world conditions; no speech or title input
recognition changes institutional affordance, not historical fact or spiritual identity
actual authorizations visible through records or actions, never Finch dialogue; do not fabricate approvals
documents have stable IDs and revision/parent lineage; no retroactive rewriting
experiments remain independent; magical receipts not experimental data
Quality-of-life records and permissions (repair requests, laundry, visits, library, meals, bedding, appointments) are core; discharge is uncommon and never the default resolution.
Assault history is character context, never a recurring scripted gag, exploit, or scheduled player challenge.

appointment ledger and envelope independently create candidate opportunity if provenance and scope match
